status: This dataset has no independently verified Forever level-60 base-stat table; it makes no universal claim about publications elsewhere. Base stats here are Classic references (grade E), derived estimates (grade D) or Unavailable (grade U); only the named pinned DB2 fields (A/B) and dated Forever guide rules (C) are Forever evidence.

A.meaning: Exact from current-build client data (DB2) or an in-game measurement.

B.meaning: DB2 value with a semantic reading.

C.meaning: Rule confirmed by a WoW Forever guide.

D.meaning: Derived or estimated (here: from Classic-reference data).
D.label: Derived estimate from Classic reference — not Forever-verified

displayRules: Grade U values are null and render as "Unavailable", never 0.
Grade E and D values render greyed with their label.
disputed: true means no single value is chosen; show every candidate with its grade and source.
approximate: true marks Classic regeneration rules whose Forever form is unknown.
applicable: false means the field does not exist for that class (for example mana for a Warrior); render as "n/a", not 0.
Computed values take the weakest grade of their inputs, ordered A > B > C > E > D > U (an estimate from Classic data is weaker than the Classic reference itself).

order: racial auras (only when includesRacials is not "yes")
procs and throughput modifiers are listed, never added

stacking.label: Classic reference — not Forever-verified
stacking.applied: Percentage stat effects multiply the total (Classic TOTAL_PCT rule, CMaNGOS StatSystem.cpp:178-183); percentage-point and flat additions from different talents or racial traits add.
stacking.display: A value that combines effects from two or more talents or racial traits is graded no higher than E and says that it assumes this stacking; a single effect keeps its own grade. Scoped effects and unmet conditions are never combined.

rounding.label: Classic reference — not Forever-verified
rounding.resources: maximum health, mana, rage and energy add flat amounts first, then multiply by percentages and round (CMaNGOS StatSystem.cpp:181-183 and 200)

evaluation.naked: appliesNaked false components and racials add nothing: item armor (Toughness), weapon/shield/wand/ranged/off-hand effects, weapon imbues and Dwarf Earth Fury (mace row).
evaluation.excluded: HolyMinMax 1.60.1.70009 data (Champion of the Light 33/66/100 with healing, sword/mace racial crit) is superseded in 70425/70450 and not used.
